recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed in core FHIR for FHIR-12630 unless a future PA decision changes Encounter.subject or the Encounter patient/subject search parameter behavior.
issue_request: FHIR-12630 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request to rename Encounter.patient to Encounter.subject, change the type from Reference(Patient) to Reference(Patient|Group), keep cardinality 0..1, add a subject search parameter, retain a patient search parameter that selects only Patient references, and document group-use cases such as anonymous group therapy and veterinary herds.
initial_application: Git commit a9b565f2261bcc91380512d34e139b86683f33d5 explicitly applied Tracker #12630 by renaming Encounter examples and the then-authoritative Encounter spreadsheet from patient to subject, changing the subject type to Reference(Patient|Group), and adding subject search metadata while retaining patient search on Encounter.subject. Later source refactors moved the active definition into structuredefinition-Encounter.xml and bundle-Encounter-search-params.xml.
additional_context: Encounter is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml defines Encounter.subject as 0..1 Reference(Patient|Group), keeps patient as an alias, and includes group-use commentary. Current source/encounter/bundle-Encounter-search-params.xml defines Encounter-patient as Encounter.subject.where(resolve() is Patient) with target Patient and defines Encounter-subject on Encounter.subject. Jira/Zulip/Confluence checks found the original issue and implementation notification but no Confluence reference or later final decision reversing this seed request.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current active Encounter source already satisfies the material Jira resolution.
